attributes.title: Keep another kind of record: an organism, a stock collection or an inventory
New tab, on your start page

childNodes.textContent: A lab inventory for things you keep or buy, or an organism database for animals you house
Vials or plates in racks inside incubators: genotype, purpose, crosses, egg collection, flip schedule and temperature shifts.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Fly vials in racks inside incubators. Label a vial with its genotype and purpose; set crosses, collect eggs into new vials and keep racks flipped.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Worm plates in boxes inside incubators. Chunk boxes on schedule, set crosses and pick progeny onto new plates, and keep frozen stocks thaw-tested.
Samples, orders, reagents, antibodies or a list of your own, with freezer boxes, mine / lab common stock, and status boards. Pick one to name it.

attributes.class: card flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 no-underline transition-all hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-sm

childNodes.textContent: Harvested tissue, blood, DNA and RNA, traced back to the animal they came from and kept in freezer boxes.

childNodes.textContent: What the lab has asked for and where each order stands, on a board from requested to received.

childNodes.textContent: Chemicals, buffers, enzymes and kits. Keep your own stock apart from the lab's common shelf.

childNodes.textContent: Chemicals by name, abbreviation, CAS number and molecular weight. A Formulation in the notebook picks them from here and works out the moles from what you weigh.

childNodes.textContent: Primary and secondary antibodies with host, clone, conjugate, validated applications and working dilutions.
